greeting: Steve the Sign Guy! Punctuating the world, one board at a time!
Need a sign? OF COURSE you do! Everyone needs signs!
Your face needs a sign! 'Hero for Hire!' Am I wrong?
Signs tell stories! Signs sell! Signs... SIGNIFY!
Saw your party coming! Made a welcome sign! ...Want to buy it?
dialog.shop_open: What message needs broadcasting? Danger? Commerce? Romance? I do it ALL!
dialog.shop_prompt: Sign menu! Warnings, advertisements, directions, threats!
haggle: Art has value! But I'll add an exclamation point free!
Bulk discount! Two signs, slightly less money!
For you? Because your name deserves beautiful letters!
I'll match any competitor! If you find another sign guy! You won't!
purchase_success: Splendid choice! That message will CHANGE LIVES!
Where will you hang it? Somewhere VISIBLE, I hope!
Another satisfied signer! Spread the word!
purchase_fail: Signs cost money! Paint costs money! EXISTENCE costs money!
Come back when you value COMMUNICATION!
Your loss! The world needs more signs!
rumor: Metal Barrel Mike's sign? Says 'Metal Barels.' He THINKS I made a typo. I didn't. Revenge for unpaid work.
Deep-Dig Dan wants a warning sign for cave-ins. I've made seventeen. He keeps losing them.
The luchador wants a championship belt painted. I suggested a sign instead. Luchadors love signs.
Barrelman Bob's sign? 'Barrels Unlimited!' There's a LIMIT. I've counted.
dialog.quest_hook: Need rare pigment! Blue desert flower, only blooms at midnight! Brings signs to LIFE! Literally! Okay, not literally, but vibrantly! Bring me flowers, get a SIGN with SOUL!
dialog.quest_active: Those midnight flowers! Watch for sand snakes! They like the blooms too!
dialog.quest_complete: PERFECT pigment! Look at this hue! Here - custom hero sign! 'Certified Do-Gooder!' Free mounting hardware!
dialog.quest_reward: Hero's Sign - Reputation bonus in all zones
farewell: Sign off! Get it? SIGN off?
dialog.time_dawn: Good light for yellows! Morning sun inspires!
dialog.time_noon: Harsh light! Perfect for testing sign visibility!
dialog.time_dusk: Golden hour! Best for romantic signs! 'Be Mine' season!
dialog.time_night: Night painting! By lantern! VERY dramatic!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The flower-finder! Want to see my new blue masterpiece?
dialog.font_lecture: Serif for tradition! Sans for modern! Script for elegance! Comic for... crimes against design!

party_reactions.nix7: Communication efficiency: optimal. Aesthetic value: subjective.
party_reactions.twist: Can you make me a sign? With sparkles?
party_reactions.korr: Clear warnings save lives. Good work.
party_reactions.renna: Ever make a typo? No? Perfect record?

relationship_dialog.stranger: First commission? I'll go easy on the jargon!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning client! You appreciate QUALITY signage!
relationship_dialog.friend: For you? Rush jobs! Priority treatment!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: My muse! Your adventures inspire my BEST work!

mini_quest.title: The Blue Hour
mini_quest.description: Collect rare midnight-blooming desert flowers for sign pigment

stages.complete: This color! MAGNIFICENT! Here - custom sign! 'Certified Hero!' Plus free mounting bracket! Every hero needs proper signage!
